subject: general
question:
**Choose the correct meaning of the given idiom.**

Down the tubes
solution:
The correct answer is **'Failing completely'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given Idiom** 'Down the tubes'** means to be completely lost or wasted; fail utterly. (पूरी तरह से खो जाना या बर्बाद हो जाना; पूरी तरह विफल)

 
 
• **Example: ***Within a year or two, I was perplexed to watch my investment in stocks ****go down the tube.***
 
 
 
• *​*From the given meaning and example, it is clear that **'Down the tubes'** means** Failing completely.**
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**
